type: Graphite producer for Western anode supply chain

investment_theses.company_type: Graphite producer for Western anode supply chain

content: Syrah Resources Limited is an Australian-based industrial minerals and technology company. The company's flagship project is the Balama Graphite Project in Mozambique, which is one of the world's largest and highest-grade flake graphite deposits. Syrah is also developing the Vidalia Active Anode Material (AAM) facility in Louisiana, USA, aiming to become a vertically integrated producer of natural graphite AAM for the global lithium-ion battery market. The company focuses on supplying high-quality graphite products to the electric vehicle and energy storage industries.

Officers

Shaun VernerFebruary 2017

Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer

Shaun Verner is a mining executive with over 30 years of experience in the resources industry. Prior to joining Syrah, he held senior roles at BHP, including in marketing, sales, and strategy. He has extensive experience in international markets and commodity trading.

Stephen WellsDecember 2018

Chief Financial Officer

Stephen Wells is a finance professional with over 25 years of experience in the mining and energy sectors. He has held senior finance roles at various ASX-listed companies and has expertise in financial management, corporate finance, and strategic planning.

Melanie LeydinMarch 2021

Company Secretary

Melanie Leydin has over 25 years of experience in the accounting profession and has extensive experience in relation to public company responsibilities, including ASX and ASIC compliance, control and implementation of corporate governance, statutory financial reporting, and shareholder relations.

James Askew

Director

James Askew is a mining engineer with over 40 years of experience in the resources industry. He has served as a director and executive for numerous international mining companies and has extensive experience in technical and corporate management.

John BeeversMay 2020

Non-Executive Director

John Beevers was appointed as a Non-Executive Director on 1 May 2023. He has over 30 years of experience in the resources and chemical industries, including as CEO of Orica Mining Services.

Non-Executive Director

Lisa Bahash has over 30 years of experience in the automotive and materials sectors. She has held senior executive roles at JCI and Ride Control, LLC, and has expertise in manufacturing, supply chain, and strategic growth.

Non-Executive Director

Sara Watts is an experienced director and executive with a strong background in finance, technology, and governance. She has held senior roles at IBM and has served on several boards in the education and health sectors.
